verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can send with "one of the official SendGrid libraries" and point to "open-source SDKs" with sample code in your preferred programming language. A concrete Node.js SDK (`@sendgrid/mail`) is shown being used. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages, in-depth SDK reference docs beyond quickstart snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
